data.notes: Only multi-stop Yacht Week diaspora/genre routes with Hvar explicitly on the route were verifiable; July 2027 venue-specific club calendars for Hvar were not yet published in the sources checked.

events.title: Rum & Music Events x Yacht Week: Cruizin' Croatia
events.venueName: Yacht Week Croatia route — Hvar stop
events.summary: A Caribbean-led Yacht Week collaboration bringing Rum & Music events, international DJs, yacht raft-ups, day-club and sunset parties to the Croatian island route, with Hvar/Fortica listed among the trip highlights.

events.title: Yacht Week Croatia Ultra Route – Carpe Diem Beach Party
events.summary: Yacht Week’s Croatia Ultra route lists a 10–17 July sailing week with EDM, house and techno programming, Ultra Europe VIP access, exclusive Yacht Week parties, international DJs, and a Carpe Diem Beach Party stop in Hvar.

events.title: Yacht Week Croatia: Hip Hop & R&B Week / Rhythm & Waves
events.venueName: Yacht Week Croatia route — Hvar, Vis and Milna
events.summary: A seven-day Croatia sailing takeover with hand-picked DJs, floating DJ decks, beach-club parties and a soundtrack spanning hip-hop, reggaeton, soca, dancehall, Moombahton and Afrobeats, with Hvar listed as part of the route.
